_about: Where courting ends (Marriage, scripts/villagers/marriage.gd; README.md, Villagers → Marriage). item: the proposal item, a keepsake (data/keepsakes.json) the general store sells (data/shops.json). Held overhead and given to a candidate it is a proposal, not a gift: yes when their heart band is at least band and the event after (%s = their id: their band 6 scene) was seen, the house extension built is done (a second room for two), and the farmer is neither married nor promised to someone else; then the knot is taken, the engaged flags set and events.propose plays. Otherwise the candidate answers with the line <id>_<why> of dialogue (why: married, taken, waiting, band, room) and the knot stays in hand; anyone who is not a candidate leaves it in the farmer's hand with messages.not_candidate. The wedding is wedding_after_days later, moved past festival days; from that morning (messages.due, the HUD tag messages.tag) the village waits at the shrine (triggers_town.json plays events.wedding from 10:00, on the day or any later one). Ours: Sayo of the store, Fumi of the teahouse Haru the straw weaver of Kaminoda Ichiro the charcoal burner of Sakurazaka Mio of the river's traps and ferry, Kaede who keeps the shrine, Shino the indigo dyer of Minamino and Ren who carries the post, open to the farmer whatever the farmer's look (docs/DESIGN.md, ความรักและแต่งงาน: all eight); 3 days to ready the shrine; the price of the knot is in the store's stock.

messages.not_candidate: A mizuhiki knot is a promise. Keep it for the one you mean to marry.
messages.due: Today is the wedding. The village gathers at the shrine from 10:00.

_help: The spouse's morning help once married (Marriage.help, from Game.end_day after the night): on a day whose weather is in weather, up to water dry tilled plots with an unripe crop are watered (row by row from the field's top-left); for each home in feed_homes whose feed box is short, up to feed portions go in from the farmer's own feed stock (none when the stock is empty). The farmer hears it on stepping out of the house (messages.watered / fed / both, %s = the spouse's name). Ours: 6 plots is two thirds of one seed bag's 3 x 3, so a small field gets a head start and a big one still needs the can; rain already waters, so only sunny days. 3 portions is half a full coop (6 hens), so the farmer still tops up most of a busy coop, and the feed is the farmer's, not free. The barn is left to the farmer. The chore done is kept as the flags help_water / help_feed for the day, for the spouse's talk lines.

messages.watered: %s watered some of the dry plots this morning.
messages.fed: %s put feed in the coop's feed box this morning.
messages.both: %s watered some of the dry plots and put feed in the coop's feed box this morning.
